# Nova API — /api/warehouses

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/warehouses`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/warehouses

Operation id `warehouses_list`: in Python `client.call("warehouses_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api warehouses_list`.

`GET /api/warehouses`: the compute classes of the platform, which one this caller may use and which one a query will land in.

Every `SqlWarehouse` of the platform namespace, largest class first (`large`, `medium`, `small`, `xs`; name order inside one size), each row carrying the class `size`, the numbers the resource group is rendered with (`running`, `queued`, `memoryShare`: the class defaults, overridden by `spec.concurrency`), `default`, `canUse` (one of the caller's groups is in `spec.grants`) and `yours` (the first usable row — the class the engine's first matching selector picks — or the default class when nothing is granted). An administrator gets one synthetic row first (`name: "admin"`, `displayName: "Administrators"`, `size: null`, 50/100/100 %: the `admin` root group access-sync renders) with `yours` on it and `yours: false` on every other row. `scale` is the scaler's verdict on the one engine the classes share (`phase`, `workers`, `queriesInFlight`, `lastQueryAt`), read from `status.scale`; `null` until the scaler has written one. Non-authoritative: the engine selects by identity, Nova only shows it. Without a cluster connection (a local run) the answer is the one `small` class. A cluster that refuses or fails is a 502. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | One row per class, largest first, the administrator's row first of all |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `502` | The cluster did not answer, or Nova may not list sqlwarehouses |

## POST /api/warehouses/\{name\}/start

Operation id `warehouses_start`: in Python `client.call("warehouses_start", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api warehouses_start`.

`POST /api/warehouses/{name}/start`: keep a class warm.

Wake the engine for one SQL compute class by writing the class's `stardelt.io/last-query-at` annotation (the scaler reads it on its two-minute tick; the replica count is the scaler's, not Nova's). The answer is `202` with `phase: "Starting"` — `status.scale.phase` is written by the scaler, not by Nova. An administrator may start any class; a person needs one of their groups in `spec.grants`. Without a cluster connection the answer is `503`; a class that does not exist is `404`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | The `SqlWarehouse` (class) name |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `202` | The annotation is written; the scaler wakes the engine on its next tick |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | None of the caller's groups is granted this class |
| `404` | No such warehouse |
| `502` | The cluster did not answer |
| `503` | No cluster connection (a local run) |
